name: Aikagi ~Hidamari to Kanojo no Heyagi~
original_name: あいかぎ～ひだまりと彼女の部屋着～
source: Takashi Murase lived an average live along his father but one day, he suddenly died in a car accident. Unable to live by himself, Takashi's homeroom teacher will start living in his house to take care of him - and her sister's joining this new family too! What will be of the three of them..?
translation: 村濑隆曾与父亲过着平凡的生活，某天父亲却突然死于车祸。由于隆无法独自生活，他的班主任决定住进家中照顾他——而老师的妹妹也加入了这个新家庭！三个人的生活将会变成什么样……？
